pending.title: Preparing Complete Culture Media
pending.summary: Prepare 500 mL of complete growth medium: thaw and optionally heat-inactivate FBS at 56 °C for 30 min, aliquot, add 10% FBS, pen-strep and L-glutamine as needed, label, store at 2–8 °C and quality-check.

pending.title: Biofilm Crystal Violet Assay
pending.summary: Static 96-well biofilm assay: grow E. coli or other bacteria 24 h, wash away planktonic cells, stain with 0.1% crystal violet, dissolve in 30% acetic acid and read A550 to quantify biofilm biomass.
pending.keywords: biofilm crystal violet assay 96-well microtiter plate E. coli static biofilm biomass acetic acid OD550 O'Toole

pending.title: C. elegans RNAi by Soaking
pending.summary: Synthesize dsRNA from a T7/T3 template, soak L4 or L1 C. elegans for 24 h in spermidine-gelatin buffer, recover on OP50 and score P0 and F1 phenotypes with proper controls.
pending.keywords: C. elegans RNAi soaking dsRNA in vitro transcription spermidine gelatin L1 L4 knockdown gene silencing
